status.macos: minimal applet build and single-command smoke passed

notes: Android external/toybox has been imported under shell/toybox/src.
The CRT overlay under shell/toybox/crt keeps the first build to a minimal configure-friendly applet set.
Applets with deeper dependencies such as gzip/libz, mount, ps, pgrep, pkill, nproc, flock, and unshare are intentionally disabled until the CRT/PAL surface is ready.
macOS/Linux rootfs uses symlink aliases for /system/bin/sh and toybox applets; Windows keeps copy-based .exe aliases.

The next shell integration gap is mksh external-command sequencing and pipeline teardown with toybox applets. On Windows this points at libc/PAL fork emulation plus waitpid/SIGCHLD fidelity rather than mksh-specific spawn shortcuts.
